title: RiskPorts: replication data and code for "Climate Variables and the Costs Generated for the Port Sector: The Case of a Port in Southern Brazil"
description:
Replication package for a study estimating the operational delays and the opportunity cost caused by weather-related stoppages at the São Francisco do Sul port complex, Santa Catarina, Brazil.

Contains the analysis dataset (4,332 vessel calls, 2018-2021) combining port operations records with meteorological and wave variables matched to each call, together with the R and Stata code that reproduces the tables and figures of the paper. Identification relies on propensity score matching followed by regression with meteorological controls.

The port operations records were originally extracted from the public waterway statistics of the Brazilian National Waterway Transportation Agency (ANTAQ). That extraction is no longer reproducible from the source: ANTAQ has restructured its statistical system and discontinued publication of the port revenue variable used in the opportunity cost estimates. Meteorological series were provided by EPAGRI/CIRAM; the values matched to each vessel call are included here, while the original station-level series are not redistributed and may be requested from that institution.
